Rapid Roast
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 20, 2009 - 11:57pm

Ingredients




1 (6 lb.) beef roast (prime rib or boneless 1 clove garlic
Salt

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 500 degrees. Rub roast with garlic and sprinkle with salt. Place roast in preheated oven. Roast for 30 minutes and turn the heat off. DO NOT OPEN THE OVEN DOOR FOR 2 HOURS. Remove. Allow roast to stand 15 minutes before carving for easier slicing. 2 Thirty minutes roasting time makes a rare roast. If you wish more well-done meat, roast for 33 or 34 minutes at 500 degrees before turning off the heat. The general rule is 5 minutes to the pound for rare and 5 1/2 to 6 minutes to the pound for more well-done meat.
